scope: Settings simplification, tab navigation, playlist append/create feedback. No running player controls, credentials, provider accounts or installed files changed.

visualReview.method: Actual Svelte settings components and shared app CSS rendered with synthetic IPC responses in an isolated headless Chromium profile. Not an installed macOS reproduction.
consolidated: Integrations navigation into Connections; legacy integrations navigation target retained
Shared AI endpoint/model/key separated from lyrics controls; existing credential storage key retained
minimized: Browser companion and assistant tools are collapsed and setup discovery is lazy
Playlist write-sync settings are collapsed with an On/Off summary
Nine playlist shortcuts render only when expanded
Soulseek shares and download settings load only when expanded
layoutFixes: Settings card headings no longer inherit page-header layout
Account playlist sidebar visibility moved to Library settings

responsiveness.measurementLimit: One baseline and two modified component mounts through two animation frames; illustrative regression evidence, not a statistical or affected-Mac benchmark.
otherFixes: Keep connection forms mounted only within Settings to retain drafts and avoid repeated service/keyring loads on tab changes
Ignore initial connection responses after component destruction
Move setup filesystem discovery, collection listing, playlist creation and unique collection writes to blocking workers instead of the Tauri UI thread
Move restored playlist mirror inspection, triggered by Library settings, to a blocking worker; its filesystem reads and review-token calculation no longer run on the UI thread.

fixes: Use dialog-local write state, not the global Working header indicator
Close after successful write, without waiting for sidebar/favorites reads
Refresh favorites only when the destination is the favorites playlist
Do not invite duplicate append retries if post-write refresh or shortcut assignment fails
Preserve existing single-flight and picker generation protection
Reuse the already-created playlist after an actual append failure
tests: Delayed append keeps picker open and single-flights writes
Slow sidebar refresh does not delay successful completion
Refresh failure after successful append leaves picker closed and does not repeat write
AI drafts retained across settings tabs without another get_connections request

supersededRun.reason: Superseded after adding the restored-playlist mirror preview worker; not a test failure.

limits: No packaged macOS reproduction or affected-user timing measurement.
Opt-in adversarial playback fixtures were not rerun for these settings/command-threading changes; existing default and alternate native suites passed.
